title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Frontier AI Benchmarks: Anthropic's Fable 5 achieved a record 89.2% score on ARC-AGI-2, while Ilya Sutskever's latest model demonstrated near-perfect reasoning on complex tasks.
AI Enterprise & Executive Shifts: Nikita Bier stepped down as X Head of Product, while Microsoft mandated GPT-5.6 Sol as the default internal coding model for developers.

National Science & Open AI Models: Arcee.ai partnered with the US Department of Energy to build Genesis-Science-1, while Firecrawl open-sourced a Rust library converting 14 document formats for LLM inputs.
Market & Energy Policy Signals: Energy market commentary turned to presidential oil price statements alongside corporate treasury initiatives allocating annual funds into youth accounts.
Media & Cultural Trends: Shaq's viral 54-year-old dunk and design breakdowns dominated general social chatter alongside nationwide launches of sports prediction markets.

items.title: @arcprize: Anthropic Fable 5 Sets ARC-AGI Record
items.body: Anthropic's Fable 5 reached a verified 89.2% on ARC-AGI-2 ($5.45/task) and 98.5% on ARC-AGI-1 ($1.02/task), setting a new benchmark for artificial general intelligence evaluation.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: Nikita Bier Steps Down as X Head of Product
items.body: X Head of Product Nikita Bier announced he is stepping down from his executive operational role to remain at the company as a strategic advisor.

items.title: @MTSlive: Microsoft Mandates GPT-5.6 Sol for Internal Devs
items.body: Microsoft leadership instructed software engineering teams to default to OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol model for all internal AI coding and software development tasks.

items.title: @OpenAI: Frontier Price & Speed Optimizations
items.body: OpenAI introduced updated model tiering focused on reducing latency and compute cost for high-volume developer workloads.

items.title: @arcee_ai: DOE Partners on Genesis-Science-1 Model
items.body: Arcee.ai announced a partnership with the US Department of Energy to construct Genesis-Science-1, an open-weight foundation model specifically for scientific research.

items.title: @geekbb: Firecrawl Open-Sources Rust Document Parser
items.body: Firecrawl released a Rust library that converts 14 document formats—including PDF, DOCX, and XLSX—into clean GitHub-flavored Markdown for LLM context windows.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: President Trump Signals Oil Price Direction
items.body: President Trump stated that administrative intervention might be considered to push domestic and global oil prices higher.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: Strategy Allocates $250 Annual Account Contribution
items.body: Michael Saylor's Strategy fund committed to contributing $250 annually into Trump Accounts for every eligible child of its US employees.

items.title: @Novig: Novig Sports Prediction Market Goes Live Nationwide
items.body: Novig launched its peer-to-peer sports prediction market platform nationwide across the US for real-time sports trading.

items.title: @Rory_Talks_Ball: Parody Accounts Beat Romano on Salah Transfer
items.body: Parody sports accounts broke major European transfer news hours ahead of traditional football journalists, sparking debate on sports reporting speed.

items.title: @weeabob: Viral Masterstroke Graphic Design Breakdown
items.body: A visual breakdown of iconic print and logo design principles garnered massive engagement across the design and creative community.

items.title: @DailyLoud: Shaq Dunks at 54 Years Old
items.body: Shaquille O'Neal went viral showing off his athletic conditioning by dunking effortlessly at age 54.

items.title: @kiteandkeymedia: The Atmospheric Science of Chemtrails
items.body: Kite & Key Media published an educational breakdown detailing the physics behind condensation trails (contrails) to dispel persistent chemtrail myths.

items.title: @unlexsi: Water Survival & Drowning Prevention Guide
items.body: A clear, actionable water safety tutorial detailing instinctual floating techniques reached millions of viewers online.
